input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
input.rationale: The grant already covers Sparkling's affiliated companies (unconditionally, without any written-notice mechanic), so the affiliate element of the fallback is met. However the licence is expressly "non-transferable", §3(c) bars Sparkling from assigning the Agreement or transferring the Work absent Garman's written authorization, and §20(d) requires the other party's consent for any assignment, so there is no path for the licence to follow Sparkling into a merger or acquisition. That fails the fallback element on a material term. The licence is otherwise perpetual while fees are paid (§17(a)) and is not revocable at Garman's discretion, so we target the fallback only: deleting "non-transferable" and adding a Sparkling-only successor carve-out in §3(c) and §20(d), while leaving the mutual consent requirement otherwise intact. Contractor coverage is a preferred-only point we have not pursued.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
mappings.quote: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations

mappings.element: The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

proposal.summary: Make the licence transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that the licence must be transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition; as drafted it is expressly non-transferable and any transfer needs Garman's consent. We have deleted "non-transferable" and added a Sparkling-only successor carve-out to the use restriction and the assignment clause, leaving the mutual consent requirement otherwise intact.

ops.oldText: (c) not assign this Agreement or transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person, except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: (c) not assign this Agreement or transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person, except to a successor in a merger or acquisition or as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;

ops.oldText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party, except that Sparkling may assign to a successor in a merger or acquisition.
